instruction: Complete the work with command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral schematic package `oscillator_core` is on the desktop. Add tolerance properties only to the required resistors. Requirements: - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. - `R42` must have `1%`; `R33`, `R39`, and `R34` must have `5%`. - Do not add tolerance to other components. Report every component in `component_properties.csv` using header `Reference,Tolerance`, leaving Tolerance empty for all other components. [Software] The available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
